messages.author: d5f6ac166990706a
messages.subject: font size change
parts:
Hello,
I have been searching for solution how to change font size: the
numbers of x axis, labels of y. Unfortunately I haven't found
anything. I know how to set font size of legend and tilte axis e.g.:
legend.text= theme_text(size = 8)
axis.title.x=theme_text(size = 10)

If it's possible at all.

I would appreciate any help.
Robert

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: font size change
parts:
Finally a question I can answer!

https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/%2Bopts%28%29-List

Go there and you should see how to manipulate each component of your graph. I think what you were looking for is


plot + opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size = 1))

Brandon

messages.subject: Re: font size change
parts:
I'm immensely indebted to you for pointing me out such wonderful page.
Trying to solve my problem one should add hjust = 1. Without it labels
are cut. Therefore:
plot + opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size = 1, hjust = 1))

Robert
